# Fission

Temporary compute operated by your local coding agent.

Start with `fission plan NAME --recipe foundry --cheapest --budget AMOUNT --region ams --duration 24h`. Choose an appropriate recipe/profile and an already agreed whole-workspace budget. Planning pays nothing and returns the quote plus exact `open` argv; opening rechecks price, hardware and authorization. `funding` supplies a structured handoff for an existing Glue Tempo-token refill policy, without inferring a wallet shortfall or authorizing swaps. Then use `run`, collect outputs and `close` when the task is done.

For client development, source recipes `foundry-source`, `reth-source`, `tempo-source` require `--repo URL --ref FULL_COMMIT` and enforce matching hardware floors. Bootstrap prepares Rust and dependencies; `run NAME build --duration 1h -- /workspace/build` compiles as a separate job. Download `/workspace/build.json` for binary provenance. Source recipes start no node; a successful compile does not establish network readiness.

Humans: `fission ui` for a minimal machine list, history, spending and SSH. Agents: `list --json`, `status --json`, `spending` and the job commands. `spending --refresh` verifies saved payment references through free read-only Tempo RPC calls; missing receipts stay unknown. UI navigation never authorizes a new purchase.

- [Agent workflow](AGENTS.md): planning, authorization, jobs, readiness, recovery, and cleanup.
- [Quick start](README.md): available capabilities and current provider limits.

Run `fission capabilities` for machine-readable provider/profile availability and `fission --help` for commands. Unavailable profiles are rejected before payment. Use a saved plan and aggregate budget; do not silently downgrade machine requirements.

Set a user-authorized VM ceiling with `fission budget --vm-max-spend AMOUNT --approve`. `fission machines --profile reth-source --region ams --duration 24h` returns only affordable compatible quotes and a labeled shortlist average. An average never increases authorization. Full Reth requires at least 32 GiB RAM and 2 TiB disk; source-build offers are not full-node substitutes. No synced deployment is verified yet.
